purpose: Prespecified exploratory direct-vs-composed direction comparison; no empirical calibration.
normalization: Sum signed unit base vectors, then unit L2 separately per pooling and layer. Same raw alpha and backend caps for each arm.
limitations: Weights are a semantic research hypothesis, not learned or optimized against generated responses.
Negative base directions are not established semantic opposites.
A selected frustration layer is not an independently optimal site for every composite.
Angered equals frustration in the composed arm; crashout adds energy and motivation. Their distinction remains an empirical question.
